changelog: Calendar dates are now tappable and open a popup showing every booking on that day, so +1/+2 entries are no longer hidden.
Calendar day popup shows booking type, name, time range and status, with direct access to booking details.
Upcoming bookings now have a Cancel Booking action; cancelling immediately frees the court slot.
Cancelled bookings are kept in a separate Cancelled Bookings group and can then be permanently deleted.
Latest 0-0-2 landscape gameplay from v1.5.2 is preserved in this consolidated update.
